findings.description: `check` now returns a list of violation messages, empty when the report is within policy. `decide` still does `if check(report, rates):`, and a non-empty list is truthy. Reports with violations (over the limit, or missing a receipt) are now auto-approved. Clean reports return an empty list, which is falsy, so they are sent to NEEDS_REVIEW. This bypasses the spending policy.
findings.suggestion: Invert the condition: `if not check(report, rates): report.status = Status.APPROVED else: report.status = Status.NEEDS_REVIEW`.
findings.title: decide() treats the list of problems as a pass/fail boolean, inverting the result
